name: actin gamma 1

function.text: ACTG1 encodes actin, cytoplasmic 2 [Cleaved into: Actin, cytoplasmic 2, N-terminally processed]. Annotated molecular activities include ATP hydrolysis activity and structural constituent of cytoskeleton. It participates in angiogenesis and axonogenesis.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to Baraitser-winter syndrome 2 (autosomal dominant); nonsyndromic genetic hearing loss (autosomal dominant). Additional curated associations are listed below.

somatic.text: This gene is included in cancer-panel definitions, but a disease-specific somatic association has not been assigned from the alteration-context sources reviewed for this draft.
